title: Best Esports Managers and Analysts (2026): Teams and Strategy
description: How to hire an esports manager or analyst for team organization, scouting, strategy or sponsorships: deliverables, how to brief it and red flags.
intro: Esports managers and analysts help competitive teams and organizations: organizing schedules, scouting players, analyzing opponents, building strategies, managing communication and preparing sponsorship materials. Good management lets players focus on playing and improving. Projects go wrong when roles are unclear, contracts and payments are informal, or strategy advice is not based on data. This guide helps teams hire support that brings structure and results.

faq.q: What does an esports manager do?
faq.a: Scheduling, communication, tournament registration, logistics, player well-being and sometimes sponsorships.
Reviews matches, studies opponents, tracks stats and suggests strategies.
Some help with sponsorship decks and outreach. Results depend on your audience and performance.
Clear agreements on roles, payments and prize splits prevent conflicts. Legal advice may be needed.
Yes. Structure helps teams at every level.
